notes: State rules for most of Spain; the Basque Country and Navarre have their own tax offices, the Canary Islands charge IGIC and Ceuta and Melilla charge IPSI instead of VAT.

items.name: Legalisation of the Accounting Books
items.rule: Within 4 months after financial year end
items.description: Filed electronically with the Mercantile Registry.

items.name: Approval of the Annual Accounts
items.rule: Within 6 months after financial year end (the directors prepare them within 3 months)
items.description: The shareholders' meeting approves the accounts and the allocation of the result.

items.name: Annual Accounts Deposited at the Mercantile Registry
items.rule: Within 1 month of approval
items.applies: S.L. and S.A.; branches deposit the foreign company's accounts
items.description: Includes the beneficial ownership declaration; the registry closes to new filings after a year of non-deposit.

items.name: Corporate Income Tax Return (Modelo 200)
items.rule: Within 25 days after 6 months from financial year end (25 July for a calendar year)
items.description: Filed online with payment.

items.name: Corporate Income Tax Payments on Account (Modelo 202)
items.rule: 20 April, 20 October and 20 December
items.applies: Companies and branches with tax due the year before
items.description: Three payments on account during the year.

items.name: VAT Return (Modelo 303, quarterly)
items.rule: 20 April, 20 July, 20 October and 30 January
items.description: Filed online with payment.

items.name: VAT Return (Modelo 303, monthly) with Immediate Supply of Information (SII)
items.rule: 30th of the following month (the end of February for January)
items.applies: Large companies, VAT groups and businesses on the monthly refund register
items.description: Invoice records are sent through SII within 4 days.

items.name: VAT Annual Summary (Modelo 390)
items.rule: 30 January
items.description: Summarises the year's VAT returns.

items.name: Annual Statement of Transactions with Third Parties (Modelo 347)
items.rule: During February
items.applies: Businesses with more than €3,005.06 of transactions with any one customer or supplier (not those in SII)
items.description: Lists the customers and suppliers above the limit.

items.name: Verifiable Invoicing Software (VERI*FACTU)
items.rule: From 1 January 2027 for companies and 1 July 2027 for other businesses
items.applies: Businesses issuing invoices with software (not those in SII)
items.description: Invoicing systems must meet the anti-fraud regulation's requirements.

items.name: Withholding Tax Return (Modelo 111)
items.rule: 20 April, 20 July, 20 October and 20 January (monthly for large companies)
items.description: Tax withheld from wages and professional fees.

items.name: Annual Withholding Summary (Modelo 190)
items.rule: 31 January
items.description: Summarises the year's withholdings per recipient.

items.name: Social Security Contributions
items.rule: Last day of the following month
items.description: Settled through the RED system.
items.authority: Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS)

items.name: Personal Income Tax Payments on Account (Modelo 130)
items.rule: 20 April, 20 July, 20 October and 30 January
items.description: 20% of the year-to-date profit, less earlier payments.

items.name: Personal Income Tax Return (Renta, Modelo 100)
items.rule: Between early April and 30 June
items.description: Reports the previous calendar year's business income.

items.name: Self-Employed Social Security Contribution (RETA)
items.rule: Last business day of each month
items.description: The monthly contribution, based on expected net income.
items.authority: Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS)

items.name: Related-Party Transactions Return (Modelo 232)
items.rule: During the month after 10 months from financial year end (November for a calendar year)
items.applies: Companies with related-party transactions above the thresholds
items.description: Transfer pricing documentation must be available from the corporate tax return deadline.

items.name: Corporate Income Tax Return — Basque Country (Álava, Bizkaia or Gipuzkoa)
items.rule: Within 25 days after 6 months from financial year end (25 July for a calendar year)
items.applies: Companies and branches taxed in Basque Country (Álava, Bizkaia or Gipuzkoa)
items.description: Basque Country (Álava, Bizkaia or Gipuzkoa) has its own corporate income tax, filed with its own tax office rather than the state tax agency. Each of the three provinces sets its own forms and dates.
items.authority: Hacienda Foral of Álava, Bizkaia or Gipuzkoa

items.name: VAT Return (quarterly) — Basque Country (Álava, Bizkaia or Gipuzkoa)
items.rule: By about the 20th–25th of April, July and October, and the end of January, on the dates the tax office publishes
items.applies: VAT-registered businesses taxed in Basque Country (Álava, Bizkaia or Gipuzkoa)
items.description: VAT follows the state rules but is filed with and paid to the regional tax office.
items.authority: Hacienda Foral of Álava, Bizkaia or Gipuzkoa

items.name: VAT Return (monthly) — Basque Country (Álava, Bizkaia or Gipuzkoa)
items.rule: By about the 25th–30th of the following month, on the dates the tax office publishes
items.applies: VAT-registered businesses on monthly returns taxed in Basque Country (Álava, Bizkaia or Gipuzkoa)
items.description: VAT follows the state rules but is filed with and paid to the regional tax office.
items.authority: Hacienda Foral of Álava, Bizkaia or Gipuzkoa

items.name: Payroll Withholding Tax Returns — Basque Country (Álava, Bizkaia or Gipuzkoa)
items.rule: By about the 25th of April, July, October and January, with the annual summary in January
items.applies: Employers with staff working in Basque Country (Álava, Bizkaia or Gipuzkoa)
items.description: Tax withheld from wages is paid to the regional tax office.
items.authority: Hacienda Foral of Álava, Bizkaia or Gipuzkoa

items.name: Personal Income Tax Return and Quarterly Payments on Account — Basque Country (Álava, Bizkaia or Gipuzkoa)
items.rule: Annual return between April and the end of June; payments on account each quarter
items.applies: Self-employed people resident in Basque Country (Álava, Bizkaia or Gipuzkoa)
items.description: Personal income tax is filed with the regional tax office.
items.authority: Hacienda Foral of Álava, Bizkaia or Gipuzkoa

items.name: TicketBAI Invoicing System
items.rule: Every invoice, as it is issued
items.applies: Businesses taxed in the Basque Country
items.description: Invoicing software must sign each invoice and send it to the provincial tax office (in Bizkaia, through Batuz).
items.authority: Hacienda Foral of Álava, Bizkaia or Gipuzkoa

items.name: IGIC Return (Modelo 420, quarterly)
items.rule: 20 April, 20 July, 20 October and 30 January
items.description: The Canary Islands charge IGIC instead of VAT.

items.name: IGIC Return (Modelo 412, monthly)
items.rule: By the end of the following month
items.applies: Large businesses and those on the monthly refund register in the Canary Islands
items.description: The Canary Islands charge IGIC instead of VAT.

items.name: IGIC Annual Summary (Modelo 425)
items.rule: 30 January
items.description: Summarises the year's IGIC returns.

items.name: IPSI Returns (Ceuta)
items.rule: Quarterly, on the dates the city's tax office publishes
items.description: Ceuta charges IPSI (tax on production, services and imports) instead of VAT.

items.name: IPSI Returns (Melilla)
items.rule: Quarterly, on the dates the city's tax office publishes
items.description: Melilla charges IPSI (tax on production, services and imports) instead of VAT.

items.name: Corporate Income Tax Return — Navarre
items.rule: Within 25 days after 6 months from financial year end (25 July for a calendar year)
items.applies: Companies and branches taxed in Navarre
items.description: Navarre has its own corporate income tax, filed with its own tax office rather than the state tax agency.

items.name: VAT Return (quarterly) — Navarre
items.rule: By about the 20th–25th of April, July and October, and the end of January, on the dates the tax office publishes
items.description: VAT follows the state rules but is filed with and paid to the regional tax office.

items.name: VAT Return (monthly) — Navarre
items.rule: By about the 25th–30th of the following month, on the dates the tax office publishes
items.applies: VAT-registered businesses on monthly returns taxed in Navarre
items.description: VAT follows the state rules but is filed with and paid to the regional tax office.

items.name: Payroll Withholding Tax Returns — Navarre
items.rule: By about the 25th of April, July, October and January, with the annual summary in January
items.applies: Employers with staff working in Navarre
items.description: Tax withheld from wages is paid to the regional tax office.

items.name: Personal Income Tax Return and Quarterly Payments on Account — Navarre
items.rule: Annual return between April and the end of June; payments on account each quarter
items.description: Personal income tax is filed with the regional tax office.
